falsifier: This first material trial is the no-control core. Fail and prohibit every risk-overlay activation if base- or doubled-cost return/Sharpe is nonpositive, fewer than four folds are positive, bull/bear/chop return or long-bull/short-bear/combined-chop attribution is nonpositive, either sleeve is inactive, any other frozen development gate fails, the lead-lag ablation is not worse, or the declared parameter neighborhood is unstable.
thesis: Without risk-overlay assistance, causal price discovery diffuses from the most liquid native-crypto contracts to slower Top-40 followers and supports an active two-sided daily spread across bull, bear, and chop after ordinary and doubled costs.
